summary: An ambient lo-fi instrument with three synths playing 64 built-in pedal recordings, each with its own piano roll, patterns and effects, arranged by scenes, a song mode and a chord machine.
features: 64 built-in recordings, 7-shape filter, layers, grit at 22 or 11 kHz
Per-synth reverb, delay and motion; shared space reverb and tape-style media
Three piano rolls of up to 256 steps, 8 patterns each
16 scenes and a song of up to 128 steps
Chord machine with 16 progressions; synths can harmonize each other
USB MIDI in/out, TRS in, clock; saves share flash with others
